WITH filtered_part AS (
    SELECT p_partkey
    FROM part
    WHERE p_name LIKE 'burlywood%'
),
lineitem_agg AS (
    SELECT
        l_partkey,
        l_suppkey,
        0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_total_qty
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey
),
filtered_nation AS (
    SELECT n_nationkey
    FROM nation
    WHERE n_name = 'ETHIOPIA'
)
SELECT
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address
FROM supplier s
INNER JOIN filtered_nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
INNER JOIN filtered_part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
LEFT JOIN lineitem_agg la ON ps.ps_partkey = la.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = la.l_suppkey
WHERE ps.ps_availqty > COALESCE(la.half_total_qty, 0)
ORDER BY s.s_name;
